prompts.hellScenery:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a hand-painted dark medieval 2.5D top-down RPG. Create ONE transparent PNG atlas, exactly 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 16 isolated objects, centered within each cell, generous clear transparent padding between cells. Genuine alpha background, no checkerboard painted, no labels or grid lines. Orthographic 3/4 overhead view, camera 30 degrees down, fronts face viewer, physical bases aligned horizontally. Match realistic weathered stone, tarnished metal and worn linen, muted charcoal, grey green, dusty umber, restrained amber lights. Soft light from upper left, no ground plane or cast shadows beyond each object. Crisp detailed silhouettes readable at small game scale, not cute, not vector.
Exact row-major subjects:
row1: 1 a low wide outcrop of layered fractured grey basalt with worn edges (no luminous lava); 2 a dead ash tree with twisted branches and exposed roots; 3 a narrow flat cold fissure in dark rock with a very faint ember seam, horizontal footprint; 4 a broken medieval stone archway with small hanging iron chain fragments.
row2: 5 a patched canvas refugee tent, empty doorway; 6 a battered copper water distiller with tank and curved pipes; 7 a small stone forge and anvil with tools and a faint warm coal bed; 8 a vertical medieval iron lottery wheel on a wooden stand with small hanging tokens, restrained blue glints.
row3: 9 a low physician worktable with linen rolls, herb jars and a shallow bowl (no people); 10 a low old stone memorial altar with carved marks and two small candles; 11 a clump of pale blue-green luminous salt moss growing on a small rock base, subdued glow; 12 a tall old iron lantern post with amber glass.
row4: 13 a small beached wooden rowboat, viewed overhead at same angle; 14 a fallen tarnished bronze bell with a length of heavy chain; 15 a waist-high wooden maintenance cabinet with small open shelves of iron rings and springs; 16 a rusted heap of discarded swords and broken spearheads tied together with cord.
No other objects, no people, no UI, no words. Each silhouette entirely contained in its assigned equal cell. Square composition.

Row1: a short wooden sleeping cot with a thin beige mattress and rolled grey travel blanket; a carpenter repair workbench with shallow trays of metal parts and tools (NO books); a small stone fireplace with warm embers; a manual cast-iron water pump with handle and short spout on a low timber plinth.
Row2: a low wooden road barricade of crossed timber beams; a fallen mossy log lying horizontally; a closed heavy medieval wooden double door in a narrow grey stone frame with a bronze circular emblem; a weathered standing boundary milestone with shallow worn carved strokes.
Row3: an open rolled blue canvas tool kit showing pliers and a hammer (NO letters); a single wooden triangular wheel chock; a loose coil of coarse hemp rope with one free end; a broken heavy iron chain passing through a stone ring, with trailing links.
Row4: a small old brass balance scale with two EMPTY pans; a wide shallow ceramic washbasin holding clear water; a small brass mechanical spindle with two gears, lying horizontally (NOT a wheel valve); a small cluster of pale milky blue crystals growing from a broken stone.
Row5: a simple straw practice dummy lashed to a wooden crosspost; a few shallow muddy animal pawprints (flat ground decal, transparent between prints); a folded cream paper map with subtle drawn lines (NO legible text); a small flat stone wall plaque with three horizontal waterline scratches, NO writing.
No people, no UI, no modern objects. Painterly realism, clean anti-aliased silhouettes suitable for in-game sprites.
prompts.hellMaterials: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: environmental floor texture atlas for a realistic hand-painted top-down dark medieval RPG. ONE square opaque image divided into EXACT 2 equal columns and 2 equal rows, each quadrant filled edge-to-edge with a different tileable material. No borders, no gutters, no labels, no perspective, no objects, flat overhead. Upper left: matte grey basalt and sparse pale ash with low contrast cracks, no large dramatic forms. Upper right: worn fine ash-grey gravel and dirt footpath, small irregular stones, calm low contrast. Lower left: earthy desaturated burnt umber soil with traces of charcoal, no luminous lava. Lower right: very old grey-blue stone paving slabs with soft chips and ash in joints. Natural subtle variation, consistent diffuse lighting, restrained texture contrast so characters read clearly. Make each quadrant internally seamless in both axes, not a scene. Avoid symmetry, concentric patterns, obvious light spots, pure black holes, large fissures. Detailed painted surfaces matching realistic weathered wood/stone RPG sprites.
prompts.objects:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2.5D hand-painted medieval RPG transparent sprite atlas. One PNG with 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, twelve isolated objects. True transparent background and generous clear gutters. No labels, no grid lines, no UI, no people, no cast shadows extending outside each sprite. Realistic weathered natural materials, subdued earth colors, soft light upper-left. Three-quarter orthographic overhead camera, fronts facing the viewer, grounded shapes, match realistic painted wood and stone fantasy game assets.
Exact row-major order:
Row1: a stoppered earthenware drinking water jug with a curved handle and narrow pouring spout (NOT an open plant pot); a small wooden hand-cranked rope winch with a horizontal drum wrapped in rope; a short broken U-shaped stone drain trough clogged with a little silt and reeds; a section of old vertical wooden wall planks repaired firmly with two horizontal boards, no doorway.
Row2: a modest wooden coat rack and low cupboard with two hanging cloaks; a narrow closed wooden wine cabinet with bottles visible behind slatted doors; a single small round wooden stool; a neatly tied brown oilcloth travel parcel with cord, NO letters or papers.
Row3: one stoppered amber glass lamp-oil bottle with a small worn blank label; a long plain medieval dining table with two pewter cups and a folded cloth, no books, no chairs; a rolled grey wool blanket with leather straps; a small open wooden book chest with several old books protected by cloth, no writing.
All twelve silhouettes fully contained within their equal grid cells, no oversized object crossing cell borders. Visible materials and crisp cutout edges, no cartoon outlines. Landscape 4:3 image.
